prior_importants.description: The new protocol line tells workers to pipe test runs to `tail` or `grep` and says `set -o pipefail` keeps the exit status, 75 included. That is wrong for `grep`. Under pipefail, bash and zsh return the status of the rightmost command that failed, and `grep` exits 1 when nothing matches. When the test slots stay busy, `runSessionTest` writes only to stderr (src/core/test-slot.service.ts:560-564), so `grep` gets empty input and the pipeline returns 1 instead of 75. A passing run piped to a failure filter such as `grep -E 'FAIL|Error'` also returns 1, so green tests look red.

findings.description: In the ADR's "The rule" paragraph, "It is one line because the context budget…" comes after the long pipefail and `grep` explanation, so "It" no longer clearly means the protocol line and could be read as the pipe rule or the filter. Starting the sentence with "The rule is one line because…" fixes this.

process_issues.description: Skipped review-security: the diff changes a static string in the compiled worker context and removes the echo of worker-written text from CLI output, with no new input handling or shell-out. Also skipped simplicity (the only new file is an ADR and nothing new was added), context, spec (no closing issue), workflow-safety and maintainability, whose gates were not met. Skipped the consolidator because only one finding was returned, so there was nothing to deduplicate.
